[***International Journal for Equity in Health***]{.journal} · 2024

\[[Article](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12939-024-02310-4)\] · \[[Code & data (OSF)](https://osf.io/jyd58/)\]

## \> *The growth in life expectancy slows down recently in several high-income countries. We utilize French census mortality follow-up data and apply P-spline models to estimate life expectancy across five occupational classes. Overall, the limited LE progress in France results from LE stalling in the middle of the gender-OC gradient, though LE increases at both ends.*
